description: Preferred store: Turso (@tursodatabase/database-wasm, SQLite-compatible Rust engine) persisted on OPFS; IndexedDB is the fallback behind the same Repository interface. Verify in the production Even WebView on Android and iOS: (1) OPFS + createSyncAccessHandle in a dedicated worker; (2) SharedArrayBuffer, which requires cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP), is available for Even-hosted plugin content; (3) DB survives force-stop/swipe-away mid-write, backgrounding, and .ehpk upgrade without corruption; (4) quota/eviction behavior (navigator.storage.persist; iOS eviction policy); (5) write latency while capturing audio. Also compare storing audio chunks as separate OPFS files (referenced + checksummed from the DB) vs BLOBs in Turso. Turso WASM is BETA and its at-rest encryption is experimental/hard to enable in WASM, so plan on app-level Web Crypto encryption regardless. Record decision: Turso+OPFS or IndexedDB. plan.md §8, §13.4.
title: Spike: Turso WASM on OPFS storage viability, audio chunk persistence, quota, forced-termination recovery
